sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Examination"."ID" AS e, "Patient"."SEX" AS g, AVG("Examination"."aCL IgA") AS m1 FROM "Examination" JOIN "Patient" ON "Patient"."ID" = "Examination"."ID"  GROUP BY "Examination"."ID", "Patient"."SEX"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v"), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m1" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: average of anti-cardiolipin antibody IgA level per Patient within Patient.SEX
gap to the all average of average of anti-cardiolipin antibody IgA level (all level)
rank within the group by average of anti-cardiolipin antibody IgA level, keep the top 3
